Minnie Estelle Thompson Rogers Downard

1880 · death year unresolved

Names in the records
Minnie Estelle Thompson, Minnie E. Rogers, Minnie Downard
Born
December 17, 1880 · Elko County, Nevada (reported)
Died
Price, Utah · date unresolved
Burial
Price City Cemetery (reported)

The supplied obituary places Minnie’s birth in Elko County, Nevada, and records a move to Nine Mile around age six. Her death year remains open.

The obituary reports that Minnie moved to Nine Mile with her family around age six. She had used the surname Rogers and reportedly had six children from her first marriage, three of whom survived her. The 1915 license notice names her and John as residents of Harper.

The reported surviving relatives include Maud May Smith, Florence Jones, Frank Thompson, Richard Thompson, John Thompson and William E. Cassaday. Their precise relationships and spellings need checking against the original notice.

Parents Richard B. Thompson, Alfalona Fausett Thompson
